utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting a nice turnout already. If you want, I can pass along the latest updates as they come in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Really? Are you sure it’s already getting a good turnout?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s what I’m hearing from folks nearby—sounds like people are showing up nicely. I’ll let you know if I hear anything more specific.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and keep people posted on the plan.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Vik — I probably would’ve missed the update, so I appreciate you keeping me in the loop.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Of course — I’ll keep folks updated as the plan comes together. If anything changes, I’ll let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’m free to help with the repair drive—what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Leo — could you bring some tape, a screwdriver, and a box of gloves? That’d really help us get the repair drive moving.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I’ll bring tape, a screwdriver, and a box of gloves.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m happy to help out with the repair drive—what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Rey — we still need a few basics like screws, tape, and a couple of tools. If you can grab whatever you have, I’ll keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can bring some screws and tape, and I’ll check for any spare tools too.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’d be a huge help. I was thinking Saturday morning, maybe around 10, so it leaves us room before the school day crowd.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me — I can help line things up around that.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, but I’ll need a clear plan for the repair drive. Tell me what needs doing first, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, sorry — first I should sort the list of what needs fixing, then we can figure out who’s bringing what and when.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good — start with the list, and then we can assign people and times one step at a time.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and invite folks right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Quinn — could you also let me know who can help and when, so I can keep the schedule straight?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll ask around and get you a quick list of who can help and what times they’re free.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard the repair drive’s coming up soon—do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: We still need a few more hands for the setup, plus donated tools and basic supplies like tape, screws, and gloves. If you can spread the word, that would help a lot.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I can do that—I’ll spread the word and keep an ear out for any tool donations too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Can you confirm the date and what items the repair drive still needs? I want to make sure I get the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m sorry, I don’t have the repair drive details in front of me right now. If you send me the date or the list, I can help double-check it.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: No problem — I’ll send over the date and items once I have them.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help, but I’ll need the details first. What’s the repair drive asking for?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m sorry, I don’t have the details yet—can you tell me what you need fixed and where to bring it?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I’d need the broken item, what’s wrong with it, and the address or drop-off spot. If you send that, I can take a look.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Gus. Do you have a drill and a set of screwdrivers I can borrow?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yep, I’ve got both you can borrow. Swing by when you’re ready, and I’ll grab them for you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m keeping track of the repair drive spots—where should I note you down?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Put me down for the afternoon shift—I can help for a couple hours.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it—I’ll note you for the afternoon shift for a couple hours.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus. I’ll let you know what tools we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No rush — I’m happy to help once you’ve got the list.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m a bit worried about the timing and who’s handling what, to be honest. If we can sort the logistics cleanly, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, fair enough — can you confirm who’s on logistics and when the repair drive is meant to start?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help with logistics if you want, but I don’t have the start time yet. Once we know who’s doing what and when it begins, I’m happy to help keep it organized.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and see who’s available to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be wonderful, Jules—thank you. I’ll keep you posted on when we need extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Of course—just send me the details when you have them, and I’ll pass them along. Happy to help however I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring a few spare supplies for the repair drive. Tell me what you still need, and I’ll check what I’ve got.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — I’ll take a look and let you know what we’re short on.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Dane — just send me the list when you have it, and I’ll see what I can cover.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks have been dropping off tools and supplies all afternoon. If you’re thinking of helping, I’d swing by soon while they’re still setting things out.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks for the heads-up, Tess — I’ll swing by after school pickup and see what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, that should still catch them in time. I’ll let you know if I hear they’re especially short on anything before then.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I’m in—just send me the repair drive details and I’ll skim them fast.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely, Bo — I’ll send you the repair drive details right away, and I’ll keep it quick and clear.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Perfect, thanks Rosa — send it over whenever you’re ready, and I’ll take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: We’re still on for Saturday morning. I’ll bring the tools and a few extra hands if we need them.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Great, that sounds solid — I’ll be there Saturday morning and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Nell, the repair drive’s coming up soon — I’m spreading the word fast. Want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, thanks, Quinn — I’d appreciate that. I’ve only heard bits and pieces, so a spot would be great.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ve got you down for a spot. I’ll keep you posted as I hear more about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m ready to help keep track of where things are for the repair drive. Just tell me what location you need me to note.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Opal. Please note the front porch, the garage, and the back shed.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ve noted the front porch, the garage, and the back shed.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana, are we still on for the repair drive this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — yes, I think so, but let me double-check the time and what we still need before I confirm.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks — can you let me know the time and what’s still needed? I’ll help get it sorted.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That sounds good — what’s the latest on the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, the repair drive — I’m still getting the details together, but I think it’s moving along. I’ll check and let you know what I can confirm.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, I appreciate it — just let me know when you’ve got the details.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’ll want to know the timing and where people should bring things first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That makes sense — I’ll get the timing and drop-off spot sorted and let you know right away.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — once you have that, send it my way and I’ll help spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting a pretty good turnout so far. If you’re heading over, I can point you to the best time to go.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh nice, I’m planning to swing by soon—what time do you think is best?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: I’d try mid-morning if you can — it’s usually lively but not too crowded yet. If you want, I can keep an eye out and let you know if it starts getting busy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I’ve only heard bits and pieces about the repair drive—what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: It’s coming together nicely—people are signing up for different fixes, and we’re still looking for a few more hands this weekend. I can fill you in on what’s left if you want.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Yeah, please—I’d love the quick version since I’ve only heard snippets. What still needs doing this weekend?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Vik — I’ll probably show up a bit late, but I’ll help where I can.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: No worries — I’ll tell everyone you’re coming late, and we’ll save you a spot. I’ll keep people posted on the repair drive plan.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks for organizing the repair drive, Bo—can you share the details first so I know what needs fixing and when?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure — I’m still gathering the list, but it’s mainly small home fixes and the drive is this Saturday morning. I’ll send the full details soon.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it — I’ll wait for the full list before I plan anything, and I’ll keep Saturday morning open for now.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Kira — I’m putting together the repair drive details now. If you have any priority fixes or supplies to add, send them my way.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — can you confirm what the repair drive is covering first? I want to make sure I’m adding the right priorities.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — we’re covering small home and block repairs like leaky faucets, broken lights, loose steps, and basic tool or material needs. Send me anything urgent, and I’ll slot it in.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Hi Sam — I’m happy to help, but I’d like a clear plan for the repair drive first. What needs to be done and when?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Eli — I’ll put together a clear list of tasks and a timeline, then send it over. I appreciate your help.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Sam — send me the list and timeline when you have them, and I’ll take a look.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—just let me know what time the repair drive needs me.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Faye. What time works best for you around the school schedule?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: After pickup is best for me, around 3:30. If you need a different window, I can try to adjust.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to stop by and help, but my memory’s a bit foggy; what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We still need to sort the dropped-off tools and check which repairs are left on the sign-up sheet.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, got it — I can help sort the tools and check the sign-up sheet. Point me to the pile and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Noah, I heard the repair drive’s picking up some momentum. Anything you still need me to keep an eye out for?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — thanks, Ira. If you spot any extra extension cords or a working drill, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Will do — I’ll keep an eye out for both while I’m out running errands. If I find anything, I’ll bring it by.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the spare screws, tape, and a couple of flashlights for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That’d be great, Cleo—thank you. I’ll make a note that you’re covering screws, tape, and flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got them set aside already, so I’ll bring them by before the drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I’ve got a few tools I can lend for the repair drive—what do you need most?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: A drill and a tape measure would help most, thanks.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend you a drill and a tape measure for the drive.
